I love this game with all my heart. I love the music, the atmosphere, basically everything about it.

There is only one thing that bothers me. In an earlier demo or earlier version, before the game came out, whenever you were killed, the characters would dance perfectly in sync with the music. They were actually doing proper gabber dancing, and it looked incredibly cool.

Now they mostly just seem to hop around.(sometimes somewhat synced) It looks very different, and it takes away a little bit from the whole feeling for me. They’re no longer really dancing to the music; they’re just jumping around, and that proper gabber-dancing feel seems to be gone.

I don’t know why this was changed or how it happened, but that is genuinely the only thing in the game that isn’t quite up to my personal standards. I really wish the old synchronized dancing would come back, because it looked fantastic.
absolute peak of gaming. my favorite game of all time. 20/10
smooth game and a good aim trainer or a warmup before you play other shooters.

It's one of the greatest games of all time and the best survival horror game of the last few decades with superb optimization and sound design. Play it patiently and plan your routes as the Alien's ai is very unforgiving. Can't wait to play the sequel.

This game should not be free. The story lines, the immersion, the attention to detail. Where Winds Meet is even customizable with their story mode setting so that even if you aren't the best at fighting, everything is still enjoyable. I have not gotten bored and I just keep unlocking new unique maps with stories that pull on your heart strings. I'm no where near finished with the game. There's just THAT much to do. I'm in loveee

It looks like it should be good, but nothing in it caught me.
The combat is slow and clunky, and the levels are pretty boring.

It's a shame because the game looks beautiful and has great potential mechanically, but it just didn't hit the mark IMO

oh what could have been. the bit. it was good, then it wasn't. If only the update ever arrived. One of the best communities i had the pleasure of playing online with. The VOIP was fantastic, the building was fantastic, even the trash talking was all in god fun. I miss you battlebit. I miss you.

Great seriously we need more game like this all i could say the game needs more working on the animations some of them looks perfect and others looks kinda not proper enough.  I would like to see more of it in the future good luck devs

Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.
For only a dollar it's a fun game to 100%, might as well try it, even though it is rather short.

it is hard to say if this game is worth or not. On one hand, its not good. The lack of maps, tools, ability and enemies makes this game extremely repetitive. The really well designed map is just not enough to save the repetitiveness. On the other hand, its just $4.99.

The game seems really fun so far, but the performance is absolutely abysmal. Turning all settings to low doesn't improve anything either.

I've experienced 3 crashes in the first hour of play.
Great game , highly recommend playing with controller to get the best experience =]

For the record, I have never played the original so I have no point of comparison. As its own game, I think its pretty neat. Combat is smooth and the difficulty is challenging yet fair. However, I've read other reviews that its only about 30% from the original game so its something to keep in mind. To summarise, its a pretty solid entry and if you liked RE2 remake, you can pick this up on a discount.

Great game, lot's of fun, highly addictive. I think adding a pvp style multiplayer would be fun too, separate bank accounts and business per team or player, fighting to buy out the better businesses and dealers first, being able to fight back and forth over territory and dealers/customers would be fun.
Loved every detail from hiding bodies and using silenced weapons to carefully planning every move. This game demands a lot of patience. Finally completed it, and it was absolutely worth the time!

Great Action Survival-horror game with an interesting enough story that makes me want to keep going until the end. Took me a while to play it, as I didnt play the original on N64 or the PS4 version. Had to get it during a sale last year and was a worth-wile purchase. Ive played RE2, RE3 and will play RE9 after I finish Alan Wake 2, which is another awesome game btw.
an absolutley fantastic game. runs flawless on steam hardware as well even if it doesnt say verified. i seriously adored this title soooooo so much
very good and challenging combat with a good story
very solid games held back by some audio and visual bugs, while i would reccomend this game i cant due to these visual bugs
Im late to the party and very new to the game.  I like it so far. I played Green Hell and it seems in the same vain. It gets DARK ! My lighter is so good. So far its a fun game.
The gameplay is repetitive, and the game doesn't have anything to offer besides the art direction.
Don't miss the game if you planning to buy it, it worth 100% 👍🏯

Excellent, kinda like a western Hotline Miami.. However there is a gamebreaking bug up until the end where you buy a perk to unlock the ability to dual wield revolvers that makes you unable to reload and have infinite ammo no matter what you do. If you don't mind being unable to dual wield revolvers by not buying the perk or if you preffer other weapons, then i highly reccomend it.. otherwise i advice you to wait until they correct this before buying it.

Absolutely rocks. Interesting loot and areas, amazing potential for worldbuilding, super innovative combat, short and sweet.  PLEASE give this one a try, by yourself or with buddies - it's great either way.

Huge props to the composer(s) too because the music is fantastic.

Very good pixel art and great enviornments. Retro feel fun for two players. It is hard to distinguish your character sometimes. It would be cool if this game had a sequel with skill trees and a way to customize colors or wardrobe items.

You don't need me to tell you this, the game has been praised universally, but I wanted to make it clear that this game is a 9.9/10 and literally the only thing that makes this not a 10, is the camera

Not because it's isometric, it's just very finnicky and limited, but if I have to put up with a bit of trying to wrangle a camera to have this masterpiece, I'll wrangle all day

8/10
souls-like with shells as classes
Combat and mechanics are great, switching shells actually changes how you play. Had a lot of fun with it.

 the last third dropped in quality. Glitchy, bosses felt poorly designed, disappointing after how strong the rest was.
Still worth playing.

this is a very fun game you will probably get about an hour out of it but id say theres definetly atleast 5 if you play it again on higher difficulty and play the remix levels if you liked dusk defintely play it. the guns feel good bit simple but not to a fault its on sale often  overall very charming and if you get it on sale definetly worth it 8/10

Much like the first game of the series, this one continues the story of Lana, but with a twist and a universal message.  The art work is fantastic, and the game mechanics are extended a bit to allow for new abilities.  The puzzles are fun (no too hard, but still a good brain exercise), while keeping you on your toes in a few of them.  And of course the story line is captivating, with plenty of cut scenes and moments that touch your heart in a way only the Lana series games can.

Above all else, it's just really fun and easy to jump in and out of as time permits.  Love.

Sworn is fun and frenetic. The action is crisp and smooth. The balance is pretty solid. Of course, there are some stronger blessings than others. I loved the meta progression, and I felt like it was all timed pretty well. The final difficulty is frankly wild. The corruptions in boss rooms on higher difficulties was one thing I did not like. Let the bosses stand on their own merits. Sworn is worth the price for sure. Also COOP!

This is my new genre which i thought to give a try with my closed friend & it was an great experience, as it's my first split screen experience so i do get a little problem in my first hour but a way out story & gameplay is more movie cinematic type & side story gives you a relax fun time to enjoy even more with your friends. yeah I'm loving the split genre.

RoboCop is a fun game that really nails the action and feel of being RoboCop. Unfortunately, it’s held back by a small map that needs more areas to explore and a serious lack of side quests. The story also feels underdeveloped, with several noticeable plot holes. Still, the combat and atmosphere are great. I recommend it for RoboCop fans, but don’t expect a deep or expansive game.
One of the best roguelite game. And saving game on the EVERY room start make this game my beloved.

A lot of cool mechanics and platforming challenges.
The campaign could be a little shorter TBH, notably the first half of it.
But it's a nice game with spatial puzzles where you have to stop and think, and with great dynamic sequences as well.

Randomizing and clearing my backlog 60/343

I played for about 6 more hours offline out of town.
This is one of the best soulslike metroidvanias I have ever played. Absolutely incredible.

This is a very complete and competently made Metroidvania. The bosses are a ton of fun and very creative. There is fun environmental, ability, and enemy variety. The story told is a cute yet also sad story of loss and friendship.
One of the most fun games i've ever played. It is a very hard game, but that makes it even more rewarding when you beat it.
A beautiful and relaxing pixel-art fishing game where you can slow down, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and catch fish at your own pace. 🎣✨
this is the type of game that is incredibly fun and entertaining for about 5 rounds, before becoming infuriatingly boring - the Godfather of all friendslop

I'm enjoying the game, but to be fair it doesn't really feel like an Indiana adventure so much as another Wolfenstein game with an Indiana coating. Maybe it will get to that point later in the game where it really feels like Indiana Jones, but so far not while in the Vatican area. 

I like all the collectibles and secrets to find, but I do not like how, so far anyway, the only point of currency is to buy books that reveal map secrets. Like, I want to find the secrets on my own, not use an in-game guide, so give me something else to spend all this money I'm finding on. 

Also the game, which I have set on the hardest difficulty, is painfully easy thus far. I'm hoping that changes.

if you like Killer Bean you will like this game. Much like the movie, this game is funny obnoxious and honestly fun to play. 

However, you can tell this is an early access game. The game would benefit alot from much more polish, as its really janky at times. The npcs are kinda stupid and the gunplay is a tad mediocre but one thing I will praise is that the movement feels really good. The combat feels intense, and is not too challenging and is very stylish.

the game is silly and i love it. excited for more updates
